_comment: Pinned offline GeoIP database (#102). Fetched only by scripts/provision_geoip.py; the DNS server never downloads it and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. DB-IP removes old monthly files: to move to a newer month, update url, size and sha256 together and run the script again.
